definitions.supplemental: The preceding section deals with wounds to the thigh. As regards the form of the word, it might be compared with O.H. Ger. walza decipula, pedica.
definitions.meaning: apparently some part of the thigh, a sinew (?)

quotations.old_english: Gif wælt wund weorðeþ, .iii. scillingas gebéte

source_text: wælt apparently some part of the thigh, a sinew (?) :-- Gif wælt wund weorðeþ, .iii. scillingas gebéte, L. Ethb. 68; Th. i. 18, 19. (The preceding section deals with wounds to the thigh. As regards the form of the word, it might be compared with O.H. Ger. walza decipula, pedica.)
